title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs now broadly exploited in the wild, still not in CISA KEV
why: Amazon (MadPot) and Hadrian report exploitation at scale, Cloudflare reports attack traffic against customers and watchTowr honeypots see exploitation attempts; NSA and CISA issued patch advisories. Both CVEs are still absent from CISA KEV (re-checked ~05:24Z Oct 22, catalog 2026.10.21). Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade to PHP 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 and restart every PHP worker; where you cannot, set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 and isolate internet-facing PHP hosts.

title: React2Shell (React Server Components RCE): new live malware infrastructure tagged on URLhaus
action: Find any internet-facing apps still on react-server-dom-* 19.0/19.1.0/19.1.1/19.2.0 (or unpatched Next.js), upgrade them, and hunt for miner processes spawned by node.

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Horizon3 published a working PoC on Oct 20; as of Oct 22 Fortinet says not known exploited and CISA KEV does not list it. No Microsoft coverage signal.
action: Upgrade FortiSIEM 7.5.0 to 7.5.1+, block tcp/27918 from untrusted networks, and check timestamps on /opt/charting/redishb.sh and /opt/phoenix/bin/phLicenseTool.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: credential-stealing release on PyPI and Docker, stolen cloud credentials abused
why: Datadog Security Labs (new OTX pulse this run) and Wiz document a malicious litellm 1.107.0 release and abuse of stolen cloud credentials. No CVE, so it cannot be in KEV or MSRC; no sign Defender tracks it specifically.
action: Search lockfiles, images and CI logs for litellm==1.107.0; pin 1.106.2 and rotate every cloud/API credential reachable from hosts that installed it.

title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to push backdoor plugins to WordPress sites (TeamUpdraft breach)
why: TeamUpdraft confirmed a breach. Patchstack telemetry and Nethemba document backdoor plugin installs from Oct 18 15:32 to Oct 19 09:23 UTC (99 distinct plugin names). This is an exploited credential-abuse campaign with no CVE and nothing in KEV.
action: Update UpdraftPlus to 1.26.13/2.26.13+, delete every UpdraftCentral key, and audit for unknown plugins (including mu-plugins) and admin accounts created since Oct 18.

title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) supply-chain compromise used to reach Microsoft 365 tenants (Storm-0940, ARTEX AI agents)
action: If ConnectWise Cloud Backup/SkyKick was ever consented in your tenant, export Entra sign-in/audit logs now, review service principal sign-ins and hunt for app credential or role changes you did not make.

title: GitLab CE/EE unauthenticated RCE via Onigmo regex integer overflow (CVSS 10), all versions since 7.0
why: GitLab's critical patch release (Oct 21), now in NVD at CVSS 10 and widely covered. Not in CISA KEV; no confirmed ITW. A public GitHub 'PoC' implements the earlier CVE-2026-97229 chain, so it does not count as a working 110264 exploit.
action: Upgrade self-managed GitLab to 19.5.1/19.4.3/19.3.6/19.2.9/19.1.9/19.0.10/18.11.13 and deploy GitLab's 'Onigmo native worker crash' and 'Org mode render error burst' detections.

title: Node.js / Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write permitting remote code execution
why: Node.js and Google Brotli disclosed an RCE-class OOB write on Oct 21; Vercel says researchers demonstrated memory disclosure and command execution, and shipped WAF rules. Not in CISA KEV; no public PoC or in-the-wild reports yet.
action: Inventory Node runtimes (hosts, containers, CI images) and move to 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1; on Debian-style builds update libbrotli; reject Brotli request bodies at the edge meanwhile.

title: Cisco Expressway unauthenticated remote root command execution (database service, persistent cookies)
why: Cisco disclosed an unauthenticated root RCE on an edge collaboration product on Oct 21. It is not in KEV. No PoC or exploitation was found in one search.
action: Apply Cisco's fixed Expressway release and restrict clustering/database ports to cluster peers only.

title: Cisco Unified CM unauthenticated access control bypass
why: Cisco disclosed an unauthenticated remote access-control bypass on Oct 21. It is not in KEV. No PoC or exploitation was seen.
action: Apply Cisco's fixed Unified CM release and limit HTTP management access to trusted networks.

title: Cisco Unified CM / Emergency Responder / Unity Connection hardening release: critical unauthenticated auth-bypass and injection CVEs
why: Cisco disclosed critical issues from an internal security review in cisco-sa-voice-hardening-twgbH9e3, now published in NVD: CVE-2026-76474 (improper authentication, CVSS 9.8 AV:N/PR:N) and CVE-2026-76473 (CWE-74 injection, 9.8). Vendor disclosure only: no PoC or exploitation seen and not in KEV.
action: Inventory Unified CM / Unity Connection / Emergency Responder clusters and apply the fixed releases listed in cisco-sa-voice-hardening-twgbH9e3; until then make sure their management interfaces are not reachable from the internet.

title: Laravel TokenGuard unauthenticated authentication bypass / account takeover on MySQL/MariaDB
why: Vendor advisory published in NVD Oct 21 (CVSS 9.2). Not in CISA KEV; no PoC or exploitation seen. Flagged on vendor disclosure alone.
action: Upgrade laravel/framework to 12.68.0 or 13.29.0 on apps that use the token API guard with MySQL/MariaDB.
